title: SIP Carrier Trunks (Tata)
description: IP-authenticated carrier trunks on UCPIN / UCDEMO / UCPMED: who is blocking whom, interfaces, listeners, whitelists, call legs and trunk logs. Source: scripts/sip_peer_metrics.py.

panels.title: Blocked at OUR end
panels.description: Nodes where our side blocks the carrier: fail2ban, firewall ipset/iptables, Kamailio secban, interface down or a SIP listener missing.

targets.expr: count(sip_peer_block_state{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Blocked at CARRIER end
panels.description: Nodes the carrier is not accepting: no OPTIONS reply (when it answered before), OPTIONS 401/403/407, or 3+ rejected call legs in 5 minutes.

targets.expr: count(sip_peer_block_state{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes OK
panels.description: Nodes with the trunk reachable and nothing blocking.

targets.expr: count(sip_peer_block_state{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Auth failures (1h)
panels.description: Call legs the carrier rejected with 401/403/407 (CALL_REJECTED) in the last hour, all selected nodes.

targets.expr: sum(increase(sip_peer_auth_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Trunk status per node
panels.description: One row per node and carrier. Blocked by: OUR END / CARRIER END / Not blocked (reasons in the next table). Interface/Source IP = the route the node uses to reach the carrier. OPTIONS: SIP status to our OPTIONS ping (0 = no reply, -1 = ICMP unreachable, blank = not probed because we block it).

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_block_state{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer, iface, src_ip) (sip_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_iface_up{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_listener_up{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", process="kamailio"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_listener_up{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", process="freeswitch"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_options_status{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_options_rtt_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_auth_failures_recent{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
time() - max by (server_name, carrier, peer) (sip_peer_last_seen_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} > 0)

panels.title: Active block reasons (who is blocking, and why)
panels.description: Empty = nothing blocked. Blocked by OUR END: fail2ban:<jail>, ipset:<set>, iptables:<chain>, kamailio:ipban, iface_down:<if>, listener_missing:<process>:<port>. CARRIER END: options_timeout, icmp_unreachable, options_401/403/407, auth_failures.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier, peer, blocked_by, reason) (sip_peer_blocked{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 1)

panels.title: Block state history
panels.description: 0 = not blocked, 1 = blocked at the carrier end, 2 = blocked at our end.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier) (sip_peer_block_state{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})

panels.title: Listening sockets (Kamailio / FreeSWITCH / HAProxy) and their interface
panels.description: Every socket Kamailio, FreeSWITCH and HAProxy listen on, with the interface that owns the address (all = 0.0.0.0).

targets.expr: max by (server_name, process, proto, address, port, iface) (sip_listener_info{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", process=~"kamailio|freeswitch|haproxy"})

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: Every real interface on the node (eth1/ens4 = private cluster network). DOWN raises SipNodeInterfaceDown.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, iface, address, operstate) (sip_iface_up{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server"})

panels.title: Expected SIP listeners
panels.description: The listeners in /etc/sip_peer_metrics.conf ('listen' lines). DOWN raises SipListenerMissing.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, process, proto, port, iface) (sip_listener_expected_up{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server"})

panels.title: Whitelists and bans for the carrier IP
Whitelisted? (per list)
panels.description: fail2ban:<jail> = in that jail's ignoreip; kamailio:trunk_ip = trusted by Kamailio secban; ipset:* = firewall allow sets (trunk_ip gates FreeSWITCH :11000 on UCPIN); haproxy:whitelist.lst = HAProxy admin/data whitelist (not SIP).

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier, list) (sip_peer_whitelisted{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})

panels.title: Bans / drop rules holding the carrier IP
panels.description: Empty = the carrier IP is in no fail2ban ban, ipset or Kamailio ipban. Allow sets (action ACCEPT/RETURN) are listed too.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier, jail) (sip_peer_fail2ban_banned{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 1)
max by (server_name, carrier, set, chain, action) (sip_peer_ipset_member{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"})
max by (server_name, carrier) (sip_peer_kamailio_banned{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} == 1)

panels.title: SIP final responses from the carrier (per 5m)
panels.description: Final SIP responses on failed legs to the carrier ([terminated][code]). 401/403/407 = authentication/authorisation.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (increase(sip_peer_final_responses_total{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"}[5m]))

panels.title: Hangup causes (per 5m)
panels.description: Hangup causes of carrier legs. CALL_REJECTED = 401/403/407/603; OUTGOING_CALL_BARRED = barred by the carrier.

targets.expr: sum by (cause) (increase(sip_peer_hangups_total{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"}[5m]))

panels.title: Authentication failures by node (per 5m)
panels.description: Carrier rejected the call with 401/403/407 (CALL_REJECTED).

targets.expr: sum by (server_name, reason) (increase(sip_peer_auth_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"}[5m]))

panels.title: OPTIONS round trip
panels.description: SIP OPTIONS ping from the node's carrier-facing IP, every minute.

targets.expr: max by (server_name, carrier) (sip_peer_options_rtt_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier"} > 0)

panels.title: Authentication failures from the carrier end
panels.description: Call legs the carrier rejected with 401/403/407 / CALL_REJECTED, with the FreeSWITCH log line.

targets.expr: {job="kazoo-node", service="sip_trunk", cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", event="call_failure"} |= "auth=yes"

panels.title: Block / unblock events (who is blocking)
panels.description: Every change of the block state: blocked_by=local (our end) / remote (carrier end) / none, with reason, interface and source IP.

targets.expr: {job="kazoo-node", service="sip_trunk", cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", event="block_state"}

panels.title: All failed carrier call legs
panels.description: Every carrier leg that did not end normally (4xx/5xx/6xx, barred, rejected, timeouts).

targets.expr: {job="kazoo-node", service="sip_trunk", cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", event="call_failure"}

panels.title: Failed legs by reason (Loki, per 5m)
panels.description: From the trunk log lines.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({job="kazoo-node", service="sip_trunk", cluster=~"$cluster", server_name=~"$server", carrier=~"$carrier", event="call_failure"} | regexp " reason=(?P<reason>\\S+)" [5m]))
